heading: How this was made: the Marginarium
first_line: Paul Bordjadze builds Paint by Moonlight and directs a small team of AI agents; the Marginarium tells how.
content_why: One passage and one picture per chapter gives the README a steady beat a visitor can scan, while the full stories wait for the app.
avoid: Avoid stacking all seven chapters' pictures on the README, which would turn the steer into clutter on stage.
